sn12.16:2.1: In jarāmaraṇassa ce mendicant, mendicant can be read as either vocative or nominative. At SN 12.67:9.1 we find jarāmaraṇassa ce, āvuso, mendicant, where āvuso is the vocative and mendicant is nominative. If mendicant was the vocative here, it would result in a repeated mendicant mendicant. I suspect one mendicant was dropped in error to avoid this, so translate as nominative.
